    Requirements

    Supported Unity version

    Tabular Editor 1.0.0 requires Unity 6000.0 or newer. UI Toolkit is included with the Unity Editor, so no separate UI package is required.

    Supported files

    Extension Separator Notes
    .csv Comma Quoted fields and embedded commas, quotes, and line breaks are supported.
    .tsv Tab Imported by the package's Scripted Importer and opened in the same editor.

    The file must be inside the Unity project so it appears as an asset in the Project window. Files under Assets and installed or embedded Packages can be opened when they are writable.

    Encoding support

    The editor detects UTF-8 with or without a BOM, UTF-16 little-endian, and UTF-16 big-endian. A file without a recognized BOM is treated as UTF-8 without a BOM.
